headwaters.title: Canad Inns Winter Wonderland
headwaters.meta: Nov 27, 2026 – Jan 2, 2027 · Red River Exhibition Park, 3977 Portage Ave
headwaters.blurb: Western Canada's largest drive-through holiday light show opens Nov 27. It runs nightly from 6 to 10 PM (closed Dec 25) and costs $30 per vehicle.

headwaters.title: Zoo Lights
headwaters.blurb: Thousands of light installations fill the paths of Assiniboine Park Zoo for the holiday season, opening tomorrow (Friday, Nov 20).

events.title: 28th Annual Juried Winterfest Craft Sale
events.blurb: Everything on the tables is 100% handmade at this juried Interlake sale, with Santa photos for the kids and a canteen run by Teulon's Farmhouse Cafe. Part of the admission goes to the Teulon Christmas Cheer Board.

events.title: Andy Haynes
events.blurb: New York comedian and TV writer Andy Haynes plays the intimate Portage Avenue basement room; the Friday show is listed as sold out, so watch for released seats.

events.title: Big Sociable 11
events.blurb: The eleventh edition of the Big Sociable, a home-grown party night at the Park Theatre.

events.title: Bisons Basketball vs. Alberta
events.venue: Investors Group Athletic Centre, University of Manitoba
events.blurb: Canada West basketball doubleheader with both Bisons teams hosting the Golden Bears. Tickets are $14 or less and cover both games.

events.title: Bisons Women's Hockey vs. Saskatchewan
events.venue: Wayne Fleming Arena, University of Manitoba
events.blurb: Prairie rivals Saskatchewan visit for a Friday-night Canada West game, the first of two this weekend.

events.title: Brenda J. Brown: Farmstead Shelterbelts — Book Launch
events.blurb: A landscape architect and professor on the tree rows that shaped the prairie farmyard.

events.title: Children's Special Day
events.time: Half-price all day; crafts 11 AM-3 PM
events.blurb: The Children's Museum marks World Children's Day with half-price kids' admission all day and a make-and-take clothespin monster craft.

events.title: Comfort Food
events.blurb: Royal MTC Warehouse production starting Nov 20; confirm closing date.

events.title: Craft Corner
events.venue: Cityplace (Farmers' Market area), 333 St. Mary Ave
events.blurb: Free lunch-hour craft sessions at Cityplace: Nov 20 is 'Wicks & Whimsy' candle scenting with Verde Candle Bar, followed by holiday card lettering Dec 4 and evergreen centrepieces Dec 18. Supplies included; registration required and space is very limited.

events.title: Death Cassette: Cheaper to Die Release Weekend
events.blurb: Winnipeg rockers Death Cassette throw a two-night party for their new record Cheaper to Die. Grab a single night or a weekend pass and get loud on Portage.

events.title: FortWhyte Alive Holiday Shopping Weekend
events.blurb: Holiday shopping weekend at FortWhyte Alive.

events.title: Fuzziekiss Release Party
events.blurb: Fuzziekiss plays live for the first time ever to launch his new single "Flash Bang Pop", and DJ Alexo keeps the bass-heavy club bangers going until 2 AM. 18+.

events.title: Grant Park Holiday Pop Up
events.venue: Grant Park Shopping Centre, 1120 Grant Ave
events.blurb: Local makers set up shop inside Grant Park Shopping Centre across two back-to-back weekends, making for easy handmade gift hunting between errands.

events.title: Harvest Market (Makers & Vendors Market)
events.blurb: Makers and vendors market. Series also has a Holiday Market Dec 18-20. From a listing site; confirm with organizer.

events.title: Hungry for Stories
events.blurb: Stories, rhymes and songs about food from around the world, plus a pretend meal to make and take home. Ages 3-5 with a caregiver; free, registration required.

events.title: JFest: Family Shabbat Dinner with Anat Kriger
events.venue: Multi-Purpose Room, Rady JCC, 123 Doncaster St
events.blurb: A community Shabbat dinner for all ages as part of JFest. $25 adults, $15 children 3+, under 3 free; registration required.

events.title: Jiaoying Summers
events.blurb: The Hulu-special comic and Tiger Mom podcast host plays a Rumor's concert series; both early shows are sold out, so grab the 9:45s.

events.title: Killers of Kill Tony
events.blurb: Regulars and fan favourites from the Kill Tony live podcast, including David Lucas, Hans Kim and Martin Phillips, each do longer stand-up sets; two shows on the rescheduled date.

events.title: Knights in Training
events.blurb: Kids ages 6-12 learn about medieval times, train to become a knight and build a castle to defend. Free, registration required.

events.title: LIM: Reds vs. Blues Improv Match
events.blurb: The Ligue d'improvisation du Manitoba pits Rouges against Bleus in a hockey-style French-language improv showdown.

events.title: Moose vs. Rockford IceHogs
events.blurb: The Jets' AHL affiliate hosts Rockford on Friday night, a cheaper way to watch the next wave of Jets prospects downtown.

events.title: Music and Makers - Holiday Edition
events.venue: The Event Space, 2nd floor, The Forks Market
events.blurb: Shop one-of-a-kind handmade gifts while non-stop live sets from emerging and established local acts keep the room buzzing upstairs at The Forks Market.

events.title: Nameless Friends (TO) w/ Screaming At Traffic and Shit Happens
events.blurb: Toronto touring act Nameless Friends headlines with two local support bands.

events.title: Nature Shop Holiday Shopping Weekend
events.blurb: FortWhyte Alive's Nature Shop hosts its annual holiday shopping weekend, a good excuse to pair gift hunting with a walk on the trails.

events.title: O. Koshetz Choir 80th Anniversary
events.venue: Oseredok Ukrainian Cultural and Educational Centre, 184 Alexander Ave E
events.blurb: An exhibit tracing eight decades of the O. Koshetz Choir, one of Winnipeg's flagship Ukrainian choral ensembles. Runs to Dec 30, alongside the choir's anniversary concert on Dec 6.

events.title: Otium
events.time: Showtimes vary; director Q&A Sat Nov 21, 7 pm
events.blurb: Christopher Beaulieu's debut feature follows a real-estate photographer shooting luxury apartments she'll never afford. The director is in attendance for a Q&A on Nov 21; screenings through Nov 24.

events.title: Quinzy
events.blurb: Beloved Winnipeg pop-rockers Quinzy play an intimate room — expect harmonies and plenty of banter.

events.title: Symphony in South Winnipeg
events.venue: Desautels Concert Hall, University of Manitoba
events.blurb: Guest conductor Dina Gilbert leads an intimate French-flavoured program of Ravel, Tailleferre (with harpist Charlene Chin), Violet Archer and Bizet's Symphony in C.

events.title: Third + Bird Christmas Market
events.time: Fri 5:30-9 PM (early bird), Sat 10 AM-6:45 PM, Sun 12-4:30 PM
events.venue: Exhibition Place, Red River Exhibition Park, 3977 Portage Ave (Gate 2)
events.blurb: Winnipeg's big curated makers' market with 170+ local vendors. Friday early-bird night is $25 advance-only; Sat/Sun general admission is $10 online ($15 cash at the door, limited), kids 12 and under free with a ticket.

events.title: Trivia Night at Club 200
events.blurb: Weekly Friday trivia hosted by Alan Fair at Winnipeg's long-running gay bar, with prizes and late-night drag shows to follow.

events.title: Unzipped (4K Restoration)
events.blurb: The 1995 fashion documentary following Isaac Mizrahi as he builds his fall 1994 collection, with Kate Moss and Naomi Campbell, newly restored. Screenings through Nov 25.

events.title: Wesmen Volleyball vs. Regina & UBC
events.blurb: Downtown Canada West volleyball: the Wesmen men face UBC at 6 PM, with the women hosting Regina the same evening.

events.title: Wesmen Women's Volleyball vs. Regina
events.blurb: The Winnipeg Wesmen host Regina in Canada West women's volleyball downtown.

events.title: Zoo Lights
events.blurb: The zoo's holiday light festival runs select nights through Jan 3: Nov 20-22 and 27-29, Dec 4-6, 11-13, 16-23 and 26-31, and Jan 1-3. November nights are 25% off ($13.50 vs. $18, ages 3+; 2 and under free), and Thomas Dambo's giant TROLLS sculptures are new on the route this year.

events.title: Seafood Boil at Devil May Care Brewing
events.venue: Devil May Care Brewing Company, 155-A Fort St
events.blurb: Raw Bar Oyster Co. serves a seafood boil of lobster, snow crab, clams, PEI mussels and chorizo, and runs a full oyster bar all day. Tickets are $80 with a drink included, and seating is capped at 75.

events.title: Holiday Alley
events.time: Various times; Straw Sculpture Burn Sat 8 PM
events.venue: Historic Downtown Selkirk (Manitoba Ave & Downtown Waterfront), Selkirk
events.blurb: Selkirk's four-day downtown holiday festival (Nov 18-21) has a soup cook-off, a new water-themed lantern parade, choral concerts, sheep poetry and the WishMe Makers' Market. It ends with the giant Straw Sculpture Burn at the Waterfront on Saturday at 8 PM. Most of it is free to explore, and some workshops cost extra.

events.title: Clearspring Annual Christmas Craft Sale
events.blurb: A three-day Christmas craft sale in the mall concourse, with local makers selling handmade gifts, decor and baking.

events.title: Eaton's Fairytale Vignettes
events.blurb: The last original storybook display from the old downtown Eaton's 9th-floor Santa annex is back for the holidays. It has 15 restored vignettes (Cinderella, Humpty Dumpty and more) plus animatronic Woodland Nutcracker characters. Free with museum admission until January 3, 2027.

events.title: Ukrainian Voice: A Legacy Mosaic
events.venue: Oseredok Ukrainian Cultural and Educational Centre, 184 Alexander Ave E
events.blurb: Oseredok's exhibition (Український голос: мозаїка спадщини) pays tribute to the Ukrainian-Canadian community, its print media and its visual memory. On view until March 31, 2027. Open until 9pm on the first Friday of each month.

events.title: Peter Shostak: Stories of a New Land
events.venue: Oseredok Ukrainian Cultural and Educational Centre, 184 Alexander Ave E
events.blurb: Highlights from Peter Shostak's beloved 'For Our Children' paintings of Ukrainian pioneer life on the Prairies. Pair it with a visit to the Christmas Fair on Dec 4-5.

events.title: The Migrant's Story
events.venue: Canadian Museum for Human Rights, 85 Israel Asper Way (Level 1, Classroom Lobby)
events.blurb: A quilt map traces migration stories, presented as part of the museum's cultural-rights programming. Free to view until April 2027.

events.title: The Incomplete Dictionary of Lexical Gaps
events.blurb: This new play opens Prairie Theatre Exchange's 2026-27 season and closes on Nov 29. The relaxed and ASL-interpreted performance is on Nov 27.

events.title: L'hiver de nos vies
events.blurb: France Adams' French-language documentary play grew out of a conversation with her aging mother about death. It weaves in stories from older Franco-Manitobans and is directed by Sandrine Lemieux. Tickets are pay-what-you-can, and the theatre lists the run as COMPLET (sold out), so check for returns.

events.title: The Whole Bloomin' Thing
events.blurb: Winnipeg's Contemporary Dancers present a work by Canadian dance icon Margie Gillis. The last three performances are this weekend.

events.title: One eye filled with night
events.blurb: A solo exhibition by Laura Lewis at Plug In Institute of Contemporary Art, on view until January 9, 2027. A curatorial talk and tour with Nadja Pelkey is on Nov 28 at 2 pm.

events.title: Maya de Forest: my brain like strips of confetti
events.venue: School of Art Gallery, University of Manitoba, 180 Dafoe Rd (ARTlab)
events.blurb: Maya de Forest's solo exhibition is in the main gallery of the U of M School of Art Gallery until January 15, 2027.

events.title: Fired
events.venue: C2 Centre for Craft, 1-329 Cumberland Ave
events.blurb: Ceramics by 33 artists from the 1950s to the 2020s, drawn from the Manitoba Crafts Museum and Library collection. It closes January 15, 2027.

events.title: Mending with Tradition
events.blurb: Jannuska's mixed-media exhibition centres on the comic The Wolf and the Eagle in the Rain, which tells Indigenous stories of motherhood, ceremony, grief and healing. On view until January 22, 2027.

events.title: TROLLS: Save the Humans
events.time: Zoo hours (also visible at night during Zoo Lights)
events.blurb: Six larger-than-life troll sculptures by Danish recycle artist Thomas Dambo, built from reclaimed materials, are on show outdoors at the Zoo. It is the trolls' first visit to Canada, and you can see them by day or lit up during Zoo Lights. Runs through February 13, 2027.

events.title: Gardener Chats
events.blurb: Members of The Leaf's horticulture team walk the indoor biomes and share what they know about the plantings and how people connect with plants. A warm escape from November grey. Chats run daily (no chats on stat holidays or Dec 25-26 and Jan 1) through January 9 and come with biome admission.

events.title: 'Go Wild' for Christmas Holiday Market
events.venue: Irvin Goodon International Wildlife Museum, Boissevain
events.blurb: Two-day market of regional artisans and crafters set among the wildlife exhibits, with hot meals, crafting with Mrs. Claus, scavenger hunts and door prizes. $2 adults, kids free.

events.title: 155th Celebration of St. Andrew's Day
events.blurb: The St. Andrew's Society of Winnipeg marks its 155th St. Andrew's Day with a prosecco reception, a Grand March, the Address to the Haggis, pipe band and Highland dancers, and a Scottish beef dinner. Tartan is encouraged. Tickets are $145 for members and $165 for non-members, plus GST.

events.title: 16th Annual Gimli Countdown to Christmas Gift Sale
events.time: Sat 9 a.m.-5 p.m.; Sun 10 a.m.-3 p.m.
events.blurb: Six rooms and 75-plus tables of handcrafted goods from local artisans on the Lake Winnipeg shore, with door prizes, a silent auction and photos with Santa and the Grinch. Free admission.

events.title: Alive in the Woods
events.blurb: A day of nature-inspired activities, crafts and games exploring connection with the outdoors.

events.title: Animals in Winter: Drop-in Activities
events.blurb: Learn about animal tracks, hibernation and migration, then go on an indoor-outdoor scavenger hunt for signs of the critters that tough out a prairie winter. Drop-in and good for all ages.

events.title: Bergen Gardens Craft Sale
events.blurb: A neighbourhood craft sale at Bergen Gardens in North Kildonan, part of the pre-Christmas sale circuit. Listed in Travel Manitoba's 2026 craft sale guide; check the organizer for hours.

events.title: Bison Bus Tour
events.blurb: Ride out onto the prairie for an up-close look at FortWhyte's bison herd in their shaggy winter coats. Also runs Nov 28.

events.title: Bisons Basketball vs. Alberta
events.venue: Investors Group Athletic Centre, University of Manitoba
events.blurb: Canada West basketball doubleheader with the Manitoba Bisons women's and men's teams hosting Alberta.

events.title: Bisons Women's Hockey vs. Saskatchewan Huskies
events.venue: Wayne Fleming Arena, University of Manitoba
events.blurb: Canada West women's hockey on campus as the Manitoba Bisons host the Saskatchewan Huskies.

events.title: Brandon Santa Parade
events.blurb: Brandon's evening Santa parade returns downtown, organized by local charities, merchants and schools, with Santa and his elves closing the show.

events.title: Breakfast with Santa
events.venue: North Kildonan Community Centre, 1144 Kingsford Pl
events.blurb: A community-centre pancake morning with the big guy himself. It's $5 for ages 4-10 and free for kids 3 and under. Cash only.

events.title: Bronx Park Community Centre Craft Sale
events.venue: Bronx Park Community Centre, 720 Henderson Hwy
events.blurb: A classic East Kildonan community-centre craft sale with tables of handmade gifts, knits and treats.

events.title: Brush and Bloom
events.blurb: Kids and their grown-ups decorate a flowerpot and plant a houseplant to take home, a bit of green for the dark months. Free, with registration required.

events.title: Calvin Christian Christmas Market
events.blurb: A Christmas market at Calvin Christian School in North Kildonan with handmade goods and seasonal treats. Listed in Travel Manitoba's 2026 craft sale guide; check the organizer for hours.

events.title: CCSAM Open House & Gear Swap
events.venue: Windsor Park Nordic Centre, 10 Rue des Meurons
events.blurb: The Cross Country Ski Association of Manitoba's annual used-gear sale and open house, the place to get outfitted and informed ahead of the 2026-27 ski season.

events.title: Coca-Cola Holiday Truck Tour at Zoo Lights
events.blurb: The illuminated red Coca-Cola holiday truck parks at Zoo Lights for two evenings of festive photo ops. The truck itself is free to see, but Zoo Lights admission is required; schedule subject to change.

events.title: Cross-Country Ski Open House & Gear Swap
events.blurb: Get a head start on ski season: score gently used cross-country gear and quiz the volunteers on how to get gliding. Sellers drop off Friday evening; bring cash.

events.title: Drag Bingo
events.blurb: Weekly Saturday drag bingo hosted by Anita Stallion, with prizes all night before the late drag show and dance party.

events.title: Family Art Afternoon
events.venue: Millennium Library, Mona Gray Program Room
events.blurb: Drop in downtown with the kids and dig into tables of art and craft supplies to make your own masterpiece. Free.

events.title: Family Nature Hike
events.blurb: A guided family walk along FortWhyte's trails exploring birds, bison and a bit of Manitoba history, best for ages 5 and up. Included with general admission; free for members.

events.title: Family Train Time
events.blurb: Drop in and build wooden train layouts together - a hit with toddlers and preschoolers. Repeats Nov 28 at Millennium Library and Dec 5 at Sir William Stephenson Library (both 2-4 PM).

events.title: Fat Ass Full Frosty Beaver Moon Half
events.blurb: Free, informal 21.1 km trail half marathon along the Red and Seine rivers, starting and finishing at The Forks. No on-course support: bring your own water, food and a headlamp.

events.title: Forest Families
events.blurb: Forest School-style unstructured nature play for families. A guided Family Nature Hike (ages 5+) follows at 1:00 PM from the Alloway Reception Centre.

events.title: Friends of the Trolls Weekend
events.blurb: Conservation and eco-minded partners set up near the giant troll sculptures to share ways to live more lightly, with a free guided tour. Troll geocaching and paint-a-pot crafting follow on Nov 28-29.

events.title: George Cotter Retrospective
events.venue: Oak Hammock Marsh Wetland Discovery Centre, 1 Snow Goose Bay (near Stonewall)
events.blurb: Retrospective presentation at the Wetland Discovery Centre. The viewing is free, with reduced $10 admission to the rest of the centre.

events.title: Heritage Needle Arts Sale
events.venue: St. Peter's Anglican Church, 755 Elm St
events.blurb: The Winnipeg Embroidery Guild's annual sale of exquisite hand-stitched pieces, a quiet gem of craft-sale season in River Heights.

events.title: House of Dreams
events.blurb: Buck, Sergio Alexo, Groove Belle, Leids and B Mitch play house, disco, melodic and Euro in the Exchange. Past editions sold out, so dress to impress and buy early. 19+.

events.title: Institution Presents: Nick Muir
events.blurb: Progressive house night with Nick Muir, John Digweed's longtime studio partner and half of Bedrock, with Winnipeg's Jereme Oliver opening. Runs to 2 AM; 18+ with physical ID.

events.title: Jets vs. Golden Knights
events.blurb: Saturday-night hockey downtown as the Jets host the Golden Knights in a heavyweight Western Conference tilt.

events.title: JFest: Ben Caplan — My Jewish Roots
events.blurb: The big-bearded, big-voiced Halifax troubadour closes out JFest with a set rooted in his Jewish heritage. $35 general admission.

events.title: L'Heure du conte en famille
events.blurb: French-language family story time: stories, rhymes and songs in a warm, relaxed setting for children and their families. 30 minutes, drop-in.

events.title: Ladies of the 80s
events.blurb: A Saturday-night tribute to the women who ruled the 1980s airwaves, at Main Street's favourite honky-tonk.

events.title: LEGO at the Library
events.blurb: Drop-in LEGO building for ages 6-12 - the library supplies the bricks. Also Nov 28, 2-4 PM, at Louis Riel Library.

events.title: Linden Woods Craft Sale
events.blurb: A long-running neighbourhood holiday craft sale in southwest Winnipeg, one of a dozen community sales on this busy Saturday.

events.title: Morrow Gospel Church Christmas Market
events.venue: Morrow Gospel Church, 755 St. Anne's Rd
events.blurb: A St. Vital church Christmas market with local vendors, crafts and baking. Listed in Travel Manitoba's 2026 craft sale guide; check the organizer for hours.

events.title: Museum Unlocked
events.blurb: An after-hours fundraising gala with exclusive gallery access, behind-the-scenes activations and food and drink.

events.title: NKMB Christmas Market
events.venue: North Kildonan Mennonite Brethren Church, 1315 Gateway Rd
events.blurb: A church-hosted Christmas market in North Kildonan with local vendors, crafts and baking. Listed in Travel Manitoba's 2026 craft sale guide; check the organizer for hours.

events.title: NRX — Northern Royals' 10 Year Anniversary
events.blurb: Cosmic Cat presents a decade-of-Northern-Royals celebration with a late-starting anniversary blowout.

events.title: Pet Photos with Santa at Animal Services
events.blurb: Bring the family pet for a five-minute session with Santa: $20 gets you one digital photo delivered on the spot (extra photos $5). Pre-booked time slots.

events.title: Photos with Santa at FortWhyte Alive
events.blurb: Photos with Santa in FortWhyte's wintery forest, $25-$45. Dates from an aggregator; confirm with FortWhyte.

events.title: Piece It Together's Christmas Quilt and Craft Sale
events.venue: Fort Garry Mennonite Fellowship, 150 Bayridge Ave
events.blurb: A quilt-forward Christmas sale with handmade quilts, textiles and crafts in Fort Richmond. Listed in Travel Manitoba's 2026 craft sale guide; check the organizer for hours.

events.title: Robots of RUSH
events.blurb: A Rush tribute night at the Pyramid for the prog faithful.

events.title: Rusalka Winter Market & Craft Sale
events.blurb: The Rusalka Ukrainian Dance Ensemble's annual winter market and craft sale is one of a dozen-plus neighbourhood craft sales on Winnipeg's busiest market Saturday.

events.title: Santa in the Forest
events.blurb: Santa trades the mall for the woods: book a 15-minute slot for professional photos among the trees on Nov 21, 22, 28 or 29. $45 ($25 members) including site admission; advance registration required.

events.title: Santa's Selkirk Sale
events.venue: Lord Selkirk Regional Comprehensive Secondary School, Selkirk
events.blurb: More than 50 tables of holiday shopping plus an on-site canteen. Admission is $2 or a tin for the bin — pair it with the final day of Holiday Alley downtown.

events.title: St. Norbert Farmers' Market - Winter Market
events.venue: St. Norbert Farmers' Market, 3514 Pembina Hwy
events.blurb: Manitoba's biggest farmers' market keeps going every Saturday through the cold on winter hours (through May 15) with local produce, baking, preserves and makers, rain, shine or snow.

events.title: The Bros. Landreth
events.blurb: Juno-winning Winnipeg roots-rock brothers The Bros. Landreth play a hometown show at the Burt with Madeleine Roger.

events.title: The Jury Experience – The Killer AI
events.blurb: An interactive, immersive mystery experience where attendees act as jurors deciding an AI's fate.

events.title: The King's School Craft Market
events.blurb: A school-run craft market featuring local makers and holiday gift tables. Listed in Travel Manitoba's 2026 craft sale guide; check the organizer for hours.

events.title: The Westward Tour: Nameless Friends / Screaming at Traffic / Shit Happens
events.blurb: A touring punk/indie bill with Nameless Friends, Screaming at Traffic and Shit Happens.

events.title: Toucan Ridge Behind the Scenes Experience
events.blurb: A 60-minute behind-the-scenes visit to the Zoo's tropical Toucan Ridge for groups of up to four, ages 10+. $46 plus GST and Zoo admission; advance registration required and the last 2026 dates are Nov 21 and 29.

events.title: Treemonisha
events.blurb: Manitoba Opera opens its season with Volcano Theatre's reimagining of Scott Joplin's opera, starring soprano Neema Bickersteth. It has a new story, a new orchestration and a 10-piece band onstage. There are three performances: Nov 21, 25 and 27. Sung in English with projected titles; tickets from $48.

events.title: truck violence
events.blurb: Buzzy noise-punk outfit truck violence brings its intense live set to the Handsome Daughter.

events.title: Wesmen Volleyball: men vs. UBC, women vs. Regina
events.blurb: Saturday doubleheader at the Duckworth: men vs. UBC at 5 PM, women vs. Regina at 6:45 PM.

events.title: Wesmen Women's Volleyball vs. Regina
events.blurb: The Winnipeg Wesmen host Regina in Canada West women's volleyball downtown.

events.title: Winakwa Community Centre Annual Craft Sale
events.blurb: Windsor Park's annual community-centre craft sale, with tables of handmade gifts and baking from local crafters. Listed in Travel Manitoba's 2026 craft sale guide; check the organizer for hours.

events.title: Wishme Makers' Market
events.venue: Gordon Howard Centre, 384 Eveline St, Selkirk
events.blurb: More than 30 local businesses spread over two floors of Selkirk's Gordon Howard Centre for a free-admission makers' market.

events.title: Garden City Christmas Holiday Market
events.venue: Garden City Community Centre, 725 Kingsbury Ave
events.blurb: A neighbourhood holiday market with local vendors and crafters in the West Kildonan area. Travel Manitoba's 2026 craft-sale guide lists it on Nov 21 and again on Dec 5, so confirm with the community centre before you go.

events.title: Watt a Season
events.venue: Manitoba Electrical Museum & Education Centre, 680 Harrow St
events.blurb: The Manitoba Electrical Museum's holiday season opens Nov 21 and runs to Jan 9, 2027. In past years it has been built around the history of holiday lighting, with longer hours and hot chocolate on December Saturdays. Check with the museum for daily hours and admission.

events.title: Trinkets & Tinsel
events.blurb: A small-town holiday market in Stonewall's Oddfellows Hall, with local crafters and vendors selling stocking stuffers and handmade gifts.

events.title: Snowflake Holiday Market
events.venue: Cooks Creek Community Club, Cooks Creek
events.blurb: A one-day holiday craft and vendor market at the Cooks Creek community club, a short drive east of the city.

events.title: West St. Paul School Craft Sale
events.venue: West St. Paul School, 3740 Main St, West St. Paul
events.blurb: A school-run holiday craft sale just north of the Perimeter, with local makers, baking and gift ideas.

events.title: Lac du Bonnet Christmas Craft & Gift Sale
events.venue: Lac du Bonnet Community Centre, Lac du Bonnet
events.blurb: Lac du Bonnet's annual Christmas craft and gift sale, a cottage-country shopping stop with local artisans and baking.

events.title: Fall into Christmas Craft Expo
events.blurb: A large craft and vendor expo in the Morris Multiplex, with handmade gifts, home decor and holiday treats.

events.title: Family Game Afternoon
events.blurb: A drop-in afternoon of board games and books for kids and their families. Free.

events.title: Family Scrabble Club
events.blurb: Friendly, non-competitive Scrabble for kids aged 5–12 and their families, with boards handed out first come, first served. Free drop-in.

events.title: La Salle Six Pack Spiel
events.venue: La Salle Curling Club, La Salle
events.blurb: A one-day social bonspiel at the La Salle Curling Club, just south of Winnipeg.

events.title: Baby, It's Cold Outside
events.venue: West St. Paul Access Centre, 48 Holland Rd, West St. Paul
events.blurb: A winter-themed craft and vendor market just north of the Perimeter in West St. Paul. Listed in Travel Manitoba's 2026 craft sale guide; check the organizer for hours.

events.title: Bison Bus Tour
events.blurb: Bus tour to see the bison herd.

events.title: Create and Connect Crafts at The Leaf
events.blurb: Drop-in family craft sessions, through Feb 7, 2027.

events.title: Esteban Seunarine with The Kind Ghosts
events.venue: The Club Room, Fort Garry Hotel, 222 Broadway
events.blurb: Drummer Esteban Seunarine blends Caribbean and Latin rhythms with prairie indie-folk as he releases his third album, The Expanding Whatever. Jazz Winnipeg presents, and the show is already more than half sold.

events.title: Housing, Inc.: A Global Takeover and Our Fight for Home
events.venue: Canadian Museum for Human Rights, 85 Israel Asper Way
events.blurb: 2026 CBC Massey Lecturer and former UN housing rapporteur Leilani Farha talks about her new book, followed by a signing. Free, registration required; doors 12:30 PM.

events.title: Lavish Events Christmas Market
events.blurb: A boutique Exchange District holiday market with 15+ local vendors, including Sips by Sammy and Dragonfly Fragrance Bar, set among photo-ready festive displays.

events.title: Manitoba Moose vs. Rockford IceHogs
events.blurb: Annual Teddy Bear Toss game where fans throw stuffed animals onto the ice after the first Moose goal, collected for local charities.

events.title: Merry Makers Market - Purl & Hank Holiday Market
events.venue: St. Norbert Farmers' Market (3514 Pembina Highway)
events.blurb: A holiday pop-up market from Purl & Hank held at the St. Norbert Farmers' Market.

events.title: New Friend Night!
events.blurb: Show up solo and get matched into board-game groups; a low-pressure way to meet fellow tabletop people ($12).

events.title: Santa in the Forest
events.blurb: Photos with Santa in FortWhyte's wintry forest setting, included with admission plus a photo fee.

events.title: Santa's Workshop at FortWhyte Alive
events.blurb: Holiday workshop experience at FortWhyte, $100-$120. Dates from an aggregator; confirm with FortWhyte.

events.title: Siamese Rescue Craft Sale
events.blurb: A craft sale in support of Siamese cat rescue, with handmade goods from area crafters. Listed in Travel Manitoba's 2026 craft sale guide; check the organizer for hours.

events.title: Tape Face
